data.one_liner: Custom tab bar widget with multiple indicator styles including vertical round, standard, linear, and round.
data.what_it_does: Provides a customizable tab bar component for Flutter applications. Supports various animated indicator styles like vertical round, standard, linear, and round indicators.
use_when: You need custom-styled tab bars with unique indicator designs beyond standard Material tabs
You require vertical or customized linear and round tab indicators
avoid_when: You only need the standard Material Design TabBar provided by Flutter SDK
You require advanced navigation routing integrated directly into the tab bar
strengths: Offers multiple distinct indicator styles such as vertical round and linear
Includes a controller to manage current index and states
Supports null safety and cross-platform compatibility
weaknesses: Limited documentation and examples beyond basic layout demonstrations in README
Changelog notes indicate historical fixes for positioning and animation edge cases
